title: 8-Hour Protection from Attacks
desc:
While protection is active, no one can send attacks against you. 

 If an enemy army is already on the way when you activate protection, that attack will still go through. 

 Protection is disabled for 2 hours after attacking another player. 

Protection is also disabled if your clan initiates a Clan War. 

If your clan is defending in a war, protection remains active — but you won't be able to send troops until it is removed. 

If you disable protection for a PVP attack or scout, it will stay disabled and will not activate again, even after 2 hours.
